full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen-and-ink illustration shows a large gabled house on a high cliff above a sea cove. The house occupies the center-right, with steep roofs, several chimneys, many small windows, and a smaller adjoining structure. A pale winding road curves past it and down toward the lower right, where a little rounded vehicle sits near a dark opening. Tall pointed trees rise behind and beside the buildings, while rolling hills and scattered vegetation extend into the upper-right distance. On the left, a broad white sun or moon sits low under thick patterned clouds, its bright disk nearly touching the horizon. Farther below, water runs along the cliff base; two small sailboats stand in the dark sea at the lower left. A waterfall drops from the land into the cove near the left middle, and pale shore or foam lines trace the edge of the cliff. The drawing is built from dense stippling, short hatch marks, and sharp black silhouettes, so trees, stone, cloud, and water each carry a different printed texture. The largest dark mass is the cliff face in the lower middle, creating a strong base below the brighter house and road. Light radiates from the large pale disk at the left, but the scene behaves graphically rather than like a literal exposure: many surfaces remain defined by patterned ink instead of smooth gradients. Tiny details in roofs and landscape reward close looking without hiding the overall coastal shape. The composition feels imaginary and storylike, balancing the luminous horizon against intricate architecture and a deep black precipice.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白钢笔画描绘一座大山墙房屋坐在高崖上，俯瞰海湾。房子占据中央偏右，有陡屋顶、数根烟囱、许多小窗和一座相连小屋。浅色蜿蜒道路从旁边弯过，向右下延伸，那里一辆小圆车停在深色开口附近。高而尖的树立在房屋后与旁边，起伏山丘和散落植物延向右上远处。左侧一轮宽阔白太阳或月亮低悬在厚重纹样云下，明亮圆盘几乎触及地平线。下方水沿崖根流动；左下深海里立着两艘小帆船。左中部一道瀑布从陆地落入海湾，浅岸线或泡沫线沿悬崖边缘延伸。画面由密集点描、短排线和锐利黑剪影搭成，使树、石、云与水各有不同印刷肌理。下方中央最大的暗块是崖面，为更亮的房屋和路构成坚实基底。光从左侧大浅圆盘放出，但场景更按图形规则运作，而非字面摄影曝光：许多表面由花纹墨线而非平滑渐层定义。屋顶与地形的小细节值得近看，却不会遮住整体海岸形状。构图充满想象与故事感，以发亮地平线平衡复杂建筑和深黑断崖。
style_prompt_en: The image uses black-and-white pen illustration with dense stippling, short hatching, and sharply reserved white areas. A large pale circular opening balances heavy ink masses, while repeated small vertical and angular shapes create detail in the middle distance. Separate textures distinguish smooth waterlike fields, cloud bands, rough ground, and fine structural edges without color. Brightness is largely made by untouched paper; shadow builds from accumulated marks rather than soft tonal airbrush. A dark lower mass anchors the lighter upper field, and winding pale routes lead the eye between them. The overall effect is intricate, imaginative, and printlike.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用黑白钢笔插画，以密集点描、短排线和清楚保留的白纸区域为主。大块浅色圆形开口平衡沉重墨色体量，中远处重复的小竖形和折角形制造细节。不同纹理在无色条件下区分平滑水般区域、云带、粗地面和精细结构边缘。亮度主要由未着墨纸面构成；阴影来自记号积累，而非柔焦渐层。深色下部体量稳住较亮上域，蜿蜒浅路在两者之间引导视线。整体效果细密、有想象力且如版画。
theme_en: A large house on a cliff above a sea with sailboats and waterfalls
theme_zh: 悬崖上的大房子俯瞰帆船与瀑布所在的海湾
